verdict.rationale: Neon documents self-serve restore through its own tooling: Instant restore docs, branch restore that keeps the connection string via `finalize_restore`, and MCP tools to create, restore and schedule snapshots. Scheduled automatic backups appear only as a single 'schedule' entry in the MCP tool list, with no documentation of how a founder sees or configures the schedule. missing for 10: documented automatic backup schedule and retention settings, a UI or console view of the schedule, detail on the Instant restore page beyond its title, independent or hands-on corroboration of restores.

support.subject: As a founder, automatic backups run on a schedule I can see and configure, and restores are self-serve

citations.quote: restores them without changing the connection string, by transferring compute endpoints to a new branch via the `finalize_restore: true` flag
Snapshots capture precise versions of schema and data; Restores allow platforms to move between versions instantly.
